page.overview:
Who is Paine's Final Fantasy X-2 battle quotes?

Paine says various lines during battle when used as a playable party member in Final Fantasy X-2 and Final Fantasy X-2: Last Mission. Her lines depend on actions taken in battle and the point in the game the player is in.

Move. —Fighting Goons or She-Goons in Luca during the first mission.

Them again? —Against Ormi, Logos, and Leblanc at Floating Ruins.

Hi there, creepy crawly. —Against Boris.
